name: DaiDripsHub give() casts an unbounded uint128 to int128
summary: DaiDripsHub.give() cast the caller-supplied uint128 amount to int128 before negating it, so an amount above int128.max flipped the balance change's sign and the hub paid DAI out of its reserve instead of taking it in. Four and a half years after deployment the attacker withdrew 24,883 DAI this way.
notes: The hub proxy has run implementation 0x8d321e80 since its 2021 deployment. None of the 52 earlier give() calls paid out to the caller; a copycat (campaign) took 3.6 DAI from another account shortly after, outside the reserve.
